{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PaymentProcessor where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Aeson (Value(..), object, (.=), encode, decode)
import qualified Data.Aeson as Aeson
import qualified Data.Aeson.Key as Key
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- Configuration loaded from environment
data AppConfig = AppConfig
  { cfgMongoHost     :: Text
  , cfgMongoPort     :: Int
  , cfgQueryMode     :: QueryMode
  , cfgSanitizeLevel :: SanitizeLevel
  } deriving (Show)

data QueryMode = StrictMode | CompatMode deriving (Show, Eq)
data SanitizeLevel = Full | Partial | Legacy deriving (Show, Eq)

data PaymentQuery = PaymentQuery
  { pqMerchantId :: Text
  , pqAmountGte  :: Maybe Text
  , pqStatus     :: Maybe Text
  , pqCustomerId :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- Simulated MongoDB query builder
newtype MongoQuery = MongoQuery { unQuery :: Value } deriving (Show)

-- Safe integer parser: falls back to default on malformed input
safeReadInt :: Int -> String -> Int
safeReadInt def s = case reads s :: [(Int, String)] of
  [(n, "")] -> n
  _         -> def

loadConfig :: IO AppConfig
loadConfig = do
  host <- fromMaybe "localhost" <$> lookupEnv "MONGO_HOST"
  port <- maybe 27017 (safeReadInt 27017) <$> lookupEnv "MONGO_PORT"
  mode <- maybe StrictMode parseMode <$> lookupEnv "QUERY_MODE"
  sanLevel <- maybe Full parseSanLevel <$> lookupEnv "SANITIZE_LEVEL"
  return $ AppConfig (T.pack host) port mode sanLevel

parseMode :: String -> QueryMode
parseMode "compat" = CompatMode
parseMode _        = StrictMode

parseSanLevel :: String -> SanitizeLevel
parseSanLevel "partial" = Partial
parseSanLevel "legacy"  = Legacy
parseSanLevel _         = Full

-- Core sanitization pipeline
sanitizeField :: AppConfig -> Text -> Text
sanitizeField cfg input =
  case cfgSanitizeLevel cfg of
    Full    -> stripOperators input
    Partial -> partialStrip input
    Legacy  -> legacyStrip input

stripOperators :: Text -> Text
stripOperators t =
  let dangerous = ["$gt", "$gte", "$lt", "$lte", "$ne", "$in", "$nin", "$or", "$and", "$where", "$regex"]
      stripped = foldl (\acc op -> T.replace op "" acc) t dangerous
  in T.filter (\c -> c /= '{' && c /= '}' && c /= '"') stripped

partialStrip :: Text -> Text
partialStrip t =
  let critical = ["$where", "$regex", "$or"]
      stripped = foldl (\acc op -> T.replace op "" acc) t critical
  in stripped

legacyStrip :: Text -> Text
legacyStrip = id  -- Legacy mode: no sanitization for backward compat

-- Query construction with mode-dependent behavior
buildPaymentQuery :: AppConfig -> PaymentQuery -> MongoQuery
buildPaymentQuery cfg pq =
  let merchantField = sanitizeField cfg (pqMerchantId pq)
      customerField = sanitizeField cfg (pqCustomerId pq)
      baseQuery = [("merchant_id", String merchantField), ("customer_id", String customerField)]
      amountFilter = case pqAmountGte pq of
        Nothing -> []
        Just amt -> buildAmountFilter cfg amt
      statusFilter = case pqStatus pq of
        Nothing -> []
        Just s  -> [("status", String (sanitizeField cfg s))]
  in MongoQuery $ object $ map (\(k,v) -> Key.fromText k .= v) (baseQuery ++ amountFilter ++ statusFilter)

buildAmountFilter :: AppConfig -> Text -> [(Text, Value)]
buildAmountFilter cfg amt =
  case cfgQueryMode cfg of
    StrictMode -> [("amount", object [Key.fromText "$gte" .= parseAmount amt])]
    CompatMode -> buildCompatAmountFilter cfg amt

-- In compat mode, amount filter still uses safe numeric parsing
-- regardless of sanitize level - never interprets user input as JSON
buildCompatAmountFilter :: AppConfig -> Text -> [(Text, Value)]
buildCompatAmountFilter cfg amt =
  let sanitized = sanitizeField cfg amt
  in case cfgSanitizeLevel cfg of
       Full -> [("amount", object [Key.fromText "$gte" .= parseAmount sanitized])]
       _    -> [("amount", object [Key.fromText "$gte" .= parseAmount sanitized])]

parseAmount :: Text -> Value
parseAmount t = case reads (T.unpack t) :: [(Double, String)] of
  [(n, "")] -> Number (fromRational $ toRational n)
  _         -> String t

-- Payment lookup endpoint handler
handlePaymentLookup :: AppConfig -> Map.Map Text Text -> IO (Either Text MongoQuery)
handlePaymentLookup cfg params = do
  let mMerchant = Map.lookup "merchant_id" params
      mCustomer = Map.lookup "customer_id" params
      mAmount   = Map.lookup "amount_gte" params
      mStatus   = Map.lookup "status" params
  case (mMerchant, mCustomer) of
    (Just mid, Just cid) -> do
      let pq = PaymentQuery mid mAmount mStatus cid
      let query = buildPaymentQuery cfg pq
      return $ Right query
    _ -> return $ Left "Missing required fields: merchant_id, customer_id"

-- Audit logging (writes query to log)
logQuery :: MongoQuery -> IO ()
logQuery (MongoQuery v) = putStrLn $ "[AUDIT] Executing query: " ++ show (encode v)

-- Main processing pipeline
processPaymentRequest :: AppConfig -> Map.Map Text Text -> IO (Either Text ByteString)
processPaymentRequest cfg params = do
  result <- handlePaymentLookup cfg params
  case result of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right query -> do
      logQuery query
      -- In production, this would execute against MongoDB
      return $ Right (encode $ unQuery query)
